summary: activities list --all and the MCP activities.list endpoint page GET /activities by page number like activities sync; --all collects rows at data.data; a page-numbered sync never sends an opaque body cursor as page=.
reason: GET /activities returns PaginationMeta (page, per_page, total, has_more) with no next cursor. The generator gave activities list --all and the MCP activities.list page config a cursor setting, so --all stopped after page one and an MCP agent following cursor_param sent cursor=, which the endpoint ignores, and re-read page one (Greptile PR #2450 thread 4514458610, P1). Live, GET /activities answers {"data":{"data":[...],"meta":{page,per_page,total,total_capped,next_cursor}}}: --all found no top-level array and returned 0 rows, and the r17 page-numbered sync picked up the opaque meta.next_cursor by name and sent it as page=, which the API answers 500 (reproduced on the demo workspace).
validated_outcome: Fixtures use the live response shape. TestNovel1219ActivitiesListAllWalksEveryNumberedPage (--all: page one then page=2, three rows), TestNovel1219ActivitiesSyncWalksNumberedPagesPastAnOpaqueNextCursor (sync: page one then page=2, 53 records, never page=<cursor>), TestNovel1219MCPActivitiesListWalksEveryNumberedPage (an MCP agent following cursor_param reads both pages); all red before the fix. Live demo workspace: activities list --all --per-page 5 returns 345 of meta.total 345 over 70 pages; sync --resources activities --full stores 345.
